subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve every workspace `.env` key ending in `_ENDPOINT`, accepting the documented migration for existing operator and plugin values?
rationale: The change closes a credible routing gap, but choosing a suffix-wide namespace is a lasting security and compatibility contract that tests and contributor proof cannot authorize.

options.title: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` globally
options.body: Accept the generic suffix rule after confirming current consumers are endpoint-routing controls and own the documented workspace-to-trusted-source migration.

options.title: Block known endpoint keys
options.body: Protect Azure Speech and other identified routing variables explicitly while avoiding a permanent reservation of unrelated future `_ENDPOINT` names.

options.title: Use owner-declared metadata
options.body: Move endpoint-variable classification to a generic provider or plugin declaration if the existing extension boundary can express it safely.

recommendation.title: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` globally
recommendation.body: Accept the generic suffix rule after confirming current consumers are endpoint-routing controls and own the documented workspace-to-trusted-source migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent workspace endpoint trust boundary was published through their security advisory, making them the best available owner for the permanent security contract.
